approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reuse the complete terminal-run workflow index to bound one exact RFI or Submittal's primary sources.
Accept only explicit Assigned To, Responsible Party, Submitted By or Reviewed By field labels under the same exact workflow scope.
Apply the same identity, role and complete-value contract to ordinary answers and comparison source findings.
Fail closed on conflicts, cross-workflow borrowing, quoted history, signatures, vision narration and oversized source sets.
Do not reinterpret Email From/To, Ball in Court, company mentions or general responsibility prose as a workflow party field.
title: Answer and ground exact workflow party fields
objective: Return bounded exact workflow party fields without provider cost and reject unsupported identity, role or value borrowing in every answer scope.
